source_note: Verified Physics Form Two scheme of work for Term I (TIE curriculum). 14 weeks: Static Electricity (Weeks 1-5), Current Electricity (Weeks 6-9), Magnetism (Weeks 11-14). Week 10 is mid-term assessment. Weeks for mid-term assessments, FTNA revision and examinations carry no specific teaching activity.
